title: Pagination shows the wrong orders
prompt:
The back-office order list is paginating wrong. With 25 orders and the default page size of 10:

- Page 1 starts at the 11th order, so the first ten orders never appear.
- The footer says there are 2 pages, so the last 5 orders can't be reached.
- On the last page the Next button is still enabled (hasNext is true).

The list comes from paginate in src/paginate.ts, used by listOrders in src/orders.ts. The doc comments on paginate and the Page interface describe what it's supposed to return (1-based pages, a shorter last page, totalPages 0 for an empty list, empty items past the end). Please fix paginate so it matches them; keep the RangeError behaviour as it is.
acceptance: Page 1 and later pages return the right slices, a shorter last page, totalPages rounds up and is 0 for an empty list, exact multiples, hasNext/hasPrev at the boundaries and past the end, input not modified, listOrders defaults.
difficulty_rationale: One function with off-by-one errors in the slice, the page count and hasNext, described by symptoms.
